{{Quote|I am pleased to report that the Cygnus Spaceworks Nemesis-class gunship exceeded all expectation during its first field test against the Rebel stronghold on Polomie.|Excerpt from Inspector-General Moff Rebu's report to the Imperial Department of Military Research|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Polomie''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="TFUII" /> located in the [[Polomie system/Legends|Polomie system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified Rebel stronghold|Rebel Alliance stronghold]] was located on Polomie.<ref name="TFUII" />

At some point by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|comic adaptation]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', and therefore the events of that [[Star Wars video games|video game]], is set in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inspector-General]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebu]] carried out an [[Battle of Polomie|attack]] on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]]. The operation served as the first field test for the new Imperial [[Nemesis-class gunship|''Nemesis''-class gunship]], which decimated the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Rebel forces]] and later returned to the Imperial base. Rebu subsequently filed a report to the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] on the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship's]] performance on Polomie.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Polomie was mentioned in "The ''Nemesis'' Gunship" entry of the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Polomie [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square J-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
